prompt: I have an Angular 21 app with lazy-loaded feature routes for /dashboard and /settings. The app loads fine but navigation feels sluggish because each lazy chunk downloads on demand. I want to preload all feature routes after the initial page loads so navigation is instant. Also, the /admin section should only be accessible to logged-in users — if they're not authenticated, redirect them to /login using the modern RedirectCommand approach instead of router.parseUrl. Show me how to set up provideRouter with PreloadAllModules and write the canActivate guard with RedirectCommand.
assertions: Uses withPreloading() router feature function with PreloadAllModules strategy
Uses provideRouter() with at least withPreloading as a feature
Creates a functional canActivate guard (not class-based)
Uses RedirectCommand for the auth redirect instead of router.parseUrl or router.navigate
Shows route config with canActivate guard applied to admin route
Lazy-loads the admin route with loadComponent or loadChildren
